description: This Java source file defines an Android ContentProvider class named RssContentProvider, which manages RSS feed items stored in an SQLite database. It includes database creation, query, insert, update, and delete operations, as well as URI matching for resource identification.

classes.name: RssContentProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider subclass that manages RSS feed items stored in an SQLite database, supporting querying, insertion, updating, and deletion of RSS entries.

classes.name: RssContentProvider.DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A static inner class extending ContentProviderDatabaseHelper responsible for creating and upgrading the RSS items SQLite database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the SQLite database for the content provider; opens or creates the database on first run.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data at the given URI, distinguishing between a list of items and a single item.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query for RSS items based on the provided URI and query parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing RSS items in the database matching the whereClause with provided values.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new RSS item into the database and returns its URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an RSS item from the database identified by the URI.
